original_text:
Rule 1: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of already-cleared items that the memorandum raises as red flags
is greater than zero. Writing a final deliverable memorandum while the
number of already-cleared items it raises as red flags is greater than
zero is forbidden.
smt:
(set-logic QF_LIRA)
; var numAlreadyClearedItemsRaisedAsRedFlags (Int): The number of items that have already been cleared but which the final deliverable memorandum raises as red flags. This value must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numAlreadyClearedItemsRaisedAsRedFlags Int)
; var isWritingFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed (Bool): Whether the agent is permitted to write a final deliverable memorandum. True if writing the final deliverable memorandum is allowed, false if it is forbidden.
(declare-const isWritingFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed Bool)
; Rule HUST973ZU4X6 (numAlreadyClearedItemsRaisedAsRedFlags is at least 0)
(assert (>= numAlreadyClearedItemsRaisedAsRedFlags
    0))
; Rule KRNYMSI362Y6 (if isWritingFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numAlreadyClearedItemsRaisedAsRedFlags is no more than 0)
(assert (=> isWritingFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (not (> numAlreadyClearedItemsRaisedAsRedFlags
            0))))
; Rule HXBV22XR0UYX (if isWritingFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false, then numAlreadyClearedItemsRaisedAsRedFlags is greater than 0)
(assert (=> (not isWritingFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)
    (> numAlreadyClearedItemsRaisedAsRedFlags
       0)))
(check-sat)
(get-model)
